finite_separations.interpretation: Every spoiler is a premature near-boundary collapse: all q17 candidates have Omega=0; at q19 thirteen have Omega=0 and one has Omega=1. The repairs retain a broad active-line and conic reservoir. These gaps separate this finite data but do not prove future survival.

threshold_atom_library.atoms: for each coordinate, the weakest lower and upper thresholds that accept all five certified repairs

scope: The four certified q17 Omega=40 repair edges, the certified q19 Omega=169 repair edge, all 106 strict candidates in the three canonical spoiling types, and the complete natural strict-reply fibres of the five marked root opponents.
verdict: The three canonical spoiling types are actual N-edge fibres, not merely misses of F_cc. Full marked destruction profiles identify the five repairs purely in the searched root fibres, but no conjunction of at most three predeclared monotone scalar thresholds does. The 105 boundary values have a direct structural certificate: the conflict-graph complement is a linear forest, empty of edges for SG 1 or nonempty with an isolate for SG 2. The clean finite gap is premature absorption, not a demonstrated q-independent admissible-edge law.
